nodes.description: transfer(address _to, uint _value) public payable; forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value)

approve(address _spender, uint _value) public payable; sets allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value

delegate(address a, bytes memory b) public payable; owner-only arbitrary delegatecall to a with calldata b
init(uint256 saleNum, uint256 token, uint256 maxToken) public; owner-only configuration of sale limits
batchSend(address[] memory _tos, uint _value) public payable; owner-only mass transfer computing total = _value * _tos.length

pairFor(address factory, address tokenA, address tokenB) internal pure; computes deterministic Uniswap pair address via keccak256

normalization_plan.reason: _to is the recipient argument that only exists to feed function transfer(); it has no independent semantic role
_value is the amount argument that only exists to feed function transfer(); it has no independent semantic role
_from is the source argument solely consumed by the internal whitelist check ensure()
_to is the destination argument solely consumed by the internal whitelist check ensure()
_value is the amount argument solely consumed by the internal whitelist check ensure()
_from is the debited account argument of transferFrom() and must be tracked with the function
_to is the credited account argument of transferFrom() and must be tracked with the function
_value drives the unchecked allowance and balance arithmetic of transferFrom()
_spender is the allowance key argument of approve()
_value is the allowance amount written by approve()
_from indexes _onSaleNum inside the internal limit check condition()
_value is compared against _minSale/_maxSale inside condition()
a is the delegatecall target argument of delegate() and is essential to the unsafe operation
b is the delegatecall calldata argument of delegate() and is essential to the unsafe operation
saleNum is a configuration argument stored by init()
token is the operand of the unchecked scaling multiplication token*(10**decimals) inside init()
maxToken is a configuration argument stored by init() (and merges into its scaling write)
_tos.length is an operand of the unchecked total = _value * _tos.length computation in batchSend()
_value is an operand of the unchecked total = _value * _tos.length computation in batchSend()
addr is the sole argument stored into tradeAddress by setTradeAddress()
factory is a hashing argument of the pure helper pairFor()
tokenA is a hashing argument of the pure helper pairFor()
tokenB is a hashing argument of the pure helper pairFor()
_name is a constructor argument stored into the name state variable
_symbol is a constructor argument stored into the symbol state variable
_supply is a constructor argument that determines totalSupply and initial balances
i is a loop index local to batchSend() with no cross-function meaning
_to is the loop-derived recipient local inside batchSend()
total is the locally computed debit amount consumed by the unchecked balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total
_UNI is the locally derived pair address checked inside ensure()

token0 is the sorted token local used only inside pairFor()
